_comment: SENNEP Pi <-> Mega protocol. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. Edit this file, then run: python3 tools/gen_msgs.py. Types: u8 i8 u16 i16 u32 i32 f32, arrays 'i16[3]', and a variable-length tail 'u8[]' (must be the last field). All little-endian. Ids 0x01-0x3F/0x40-0x7F: Pi->Mega. 0x80-0xFF: Mega->Pi.

messages.name: HEARTBEAT
messages.doc: Keeps the link watchdog fed when no CMD_DRIVE is sent.

messages.name: ARM
messages.doc: DISARMED -> ARMED. Rejected (ACK result) if e-stop/fault active.

messages.name: DISARM
messages.doc: Any state -> DISARMED (also clears ESTOP_SW / LINK_LOST).

messages.name: ESTOP_SW
messages.doc: Software e-stop. Latched until DISARM.

messages.name: CMD_DRIVE
messages.doc: Body velocity. vx forward, vy left, wz counter-clockwise. Also feeds the watchdog.

messages.name: CMD_WHEELS
messages.doc: Direct wheel duty (test/calibration). Order FL, FR, RL, RR. -1000..1000.

messages.name: SET_PARAM
messages.doc: Set a runtime parameter (RAM only). Answered by ACK.

messages.name: GET_PARAM
messages.doc: Read a parameter. Answered by ACK with value.

messages.name: SET_OUTPUT
messages.doc: Set a simple output (lights, buzzer).

messages.name: TIME_SYNC
messages.doc: Answered immediately by TIME_SYNC_REPLY.

messages.name: NODE_SEND
messages.doc: Forward a raw (un-COBS'ed) frame to an expansion node port.

messages.name: HELLO
messages.doc: Sent at boot and at 2 Hz until the Pi talks.

messages.name: STATUS
messages.doc: 10 Hz health.

messages.name: IMU
messages.doc: Raw MPU-6050 (default +-2 g, +-250 dps).

messages.name: MAG
messages.doc: Raw QMC5883L.

messages.name: RANGES
messages.doc: 0 = no reading. tof_mm order counter-clockwise from front: F, FL, L, RL, B, RR, R, FR. sonar_mm: F, L, B, R. edge_bits: 1 = no floor, bit 0..3 = FL, FR, RL, RR corner.

messages.name: MOTORS
messages.doc: Applied duty after ramp/blocking, and raw BTS7960 IS readings.

messages.name: RC
messages.doc: RF joystick (NRF24) when active.

messages.name: TIME_SYNC_REPLY
messages.doc: Echo of t_pi_us plus Mega micros() at reception.

messages.name: ACK
messages.doc: Reply to ARM/DISARM/SET_PARAM/GET_PARAM/SET_OUTPUT/NODE_SEND.

messages.name: LOG
messages.doc: Short text.

messages.name: NODE_FRAME
messages.doc: A raw frame received from an expansion node, forwarded unchanged.
